environment.description: EKS pod running on Bottlerocket nodes with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via annotations (container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/order-consumer=localhost/order-svc-confined). The profile denies write access to all paths except /tmp/order-svc-scratch/** and explicitly denies /var/log/** with 'deny /var/log/** w,'. The pod also has a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with an emptyDir volume mounted at /tmp/order-svc-scratch for ephemeral state. The application's LOG_PATH environment variable is set to /var/log/order-service/events.log but the AppArmor profile combined with the read-only filesystem prevents any write to that path. Additionally, the Bottlerocket host has SELinux in enforcing mode with container_t context applied, which independently restricts container file writes to labeled volumes only.

config.apparmor_profile: order-svc-confined (deny /var/log/** w, deny /etc/** w, deny /usr/** w)
